dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000r1n3](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000r1n3) Magnitude 5.8 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Aug 16 2025 15km N of Poso. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -1.2569 longitude 120.7409. It impacted 125469 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
